info.name: Git-Inside API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Git-Inside backend (Group 3, Git Git Aw - CS-B).

Steps: 1) Start MySQL in XAMPP and run the backend (npm run dev). 2) Run 'npm run seed' once for demo data. 3) Run 01 Auth > Login - Landlord, then Login - Tenant Ana. Tokens are saved automatically. 4) Run the other requests. Requests marked '(change id)' need a real id from the matching list request.

request.description: Run this first. It saves the token automatically.
In development the response includes resetToken (no email, by design).
Sets the password back to Tenant123! so demo logins keep working.
Tenant ids depend on the seed. Check List tenants first.
Use the id of the pending tenant from the list.
Change tenantId/roomId to a tenant without a lease and a vacant room.
In the Body tab, click Select Files for the 'proof' row and choose a JPG/PNG. Change the payment id.
Needs the fix to payments.js that is included in this backend zip.
